title: Even Kids Are Building AI Agents Now: OpenAI's Big Shift
description:
Even kids are building AI agents while some of us still "thinking about starting" 😅

According to a OpenAI study, 40% of kids use generative AI every single week but only 30% of parents even know it's happening. That gap is basically what driving the whole product race right now. It's why OpenAI just went and hired their first ever product manager focused only on families, seniors and caregivers.

and the numbers flipped fast. In one year seniors went from 16 to 24% of US users, and the over 40 crowd grew 26 to 30%. AI quietly turned from a developer toy into a mainstream family thing, sitting right next to Google and Apple 🔥✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
